game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Peak Beacon, the beacon on the peak: the sherpa guide must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Frequency Bazaar: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary.
theme: Frost Peaks – Peak Beacon: the beacon on the peak
core_gameplay_loop: In Peak Beacon, repeat each round: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the tally value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the radio mast using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The radio mast reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the radio mast is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 2 (intro tier): Frequency Bazaar
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Frequency Bazaar' (Week 8 slot 9), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Peak Beacon'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tally changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice hawks in Peak Beacon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The radio mast reached with actions_used <= 11.
